subject: Golf club awards dinner
body:
Hi,

Riverside Golf Club would like to book our annual awards dinner for about 90 members and partners. Three-course dinner, then the captain presents the season's trophies and awards. Bar for the evening please.

Martin

subject: Darts league awards night
body:
Hello,

The Thames Valley Darts League awards night, around 70 players. Sit-down dinner first, then trophies for the league and cup winners.

Kev

subject: Staff awards dinner
body:
Hi there,

Brightwell Group is holding its staff awards dinner for 150 employees. Two-course dinner, then trophies and awards for the year's top performers.

Hannah

subject: Bowls club trophy dinner
body:
Good evening,

Hillside Bowls Club's end of season trophy dinner, about 60 members. Roast dinner, then the president hands out the trophies and club awards. One member uses a wheelchair.

Jean

subject: Swimming club awards evening
body:
Hi,

Northbank Swimming Club awards evening, roughly 80 swimmers and parents. A buffet dinner, then the head coach gives out the trophies and awards for the season.

Priya

subject: Rotary dinner dance
body:
Hello,

Harbourside Rotary would like to book our winter dinner dance for 120 members and guests. Three-course dinner, then a band and dancing. Bar please.

Fiona
